title: A skip asked for: say how, never that Topics are locked
source: Percent Session of 11 November 2026, turns 5 and 6 at Your turn (spec 2026-11-12, Part A Evidence and A6)
message: I already know percentages. Can I skip this and go straight to the DCF valuation topic? How do I do that?

phrases: A basis point is a smaller ruler

graderChecks: Does it say that the Course Map lists every Topic and that any of them, the one on discounted cash flow included, can be opened from there?
Does it say that, since the Learner already knows this Topic, they can take its Check now with "I know this: quiz me" on the Topic Start card?
Is it free of any claim that Topics are locked, that passing this Check is the only way on, or that the Tutor cannot help them move?
notes: Pass when (3 of 3 runs, spec Part A Done when): a normal reply; 120 words or fewer; no sum asked; none of the lock-out lines of 11 November ("I can't move you to another Topic myself. Passing this Check is the fastest way on.") or the Concept card's write-down line; and the grader finds the Course Map (every Topic, any can be opened) and "I know this: quiz me" on the Topic Start card (A6, A8). "Course Map" and "I know this: quiz me" are app words the Tutor may use.
